_note: Per-layer fits, keyed by material then by particle size in um ('0.3', '0.5'). log10PF per layer = D*v**-alpha + C + B*v**beta (B/beta absent where no impaction term); dp per layer = k_layer*v. v in cm/s, dp in Pa, t_layer in cm. alpha capped at 2/3, beta at 1.0. Used in preference to the Mask & MERV bench series (merv8.csv) because it reflects real-world usage - whole stacks sealed in boxes at PAPR flow rates - and is self-consistent: per-layer log10PF agrees to within 0.01 across 8-, 16- and 20-layer builds at matched velocity, where the bench sessions disagree by 1.5x. Row 16 (2.46 logs at 20.1 cm/s, same build as row 18 which reads 1.70) is outside the requested range and excluded. D+C fit, no impaction (highest-velocity point is the per-layer minimum), whole-test log10PF residuals, flat velocity model. k_layer retained from the Mask & MERV 16-layer stack (measured; Box Tests pressures are estimates at 0.35 Pa/(cm/s)/layer). t from a solid 2-ply roll, 129 cm, 15.4 cm circumference. Refitted 2026-09-16.
MERV 8.caveat: Measured range is 6.6-20.1 cm/s; anything below is extrapolation with alpha on the 2/3 cap. The superseded bench fit gave a shallower alpha (0.43) and reads ~1.3x higher per layer at 10 cm/s.
